name: Key Lime Pie Tarantula | 1g
description:
Tangy lime with a buttery crust finish. Sativa, so the high starts in the head and works its way down. The sourness is real — this one actually makes your mouth water. Balanced and flavorful, good for pretty much any time of day.

* Liquid Diamond Infused: Injected with concentrate for amplified potency.
* Kief Crusted: Rolled in kief for an extra layer of flavor and THC.
